ui.faq.title: Questions teams ask first
ui.faq.q2: Does it work on phones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app covers work on the ground, such as notes, treatments, transfers and egg records. The web app covers desk work, such as the hospital system, nursery set-up, reports and pharmacy stock. Updates appear in real time on phone, tablet and desktop.
ui.faq.q3: Can we control who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is role-based. You create the roles your organisation uses, for example Zoologist, and turn permissions on module by module.
ui.faq.q4: We run more than one site. Does that work?
ui.faq.a4: Antz keeps data from every site and department in one place. Housing is organised by site, section and enclosure, and moves between sites go through approval and a security check-out.
ui.faq.a5: Start with the Getting Started guide, then open the modules your role uses. If something is unclear, write to hello@antz.systems.

objective-of-this-kit.title: Objective of this kit
objective-of-this-kit.intro: Onboarding has four jobs: get every team member confident in their day-to-day activities, get the platform adopted across roles, identify gaps so we can improve, and standardise how records are kept across sites.

features.title: Skill development
features.desc: Enhance staff knowledge and the practical skills needed for effective zoo operations, animal care, and confident use of the Antz platform.

features.title: System adoption
features.desc: Familiarize users with every app module and build confidence to perform the core actions like recording, reviewing and approving without supervision.

features.title: Continuous improvement
features.desc: Identify the gaps, clarify the doubts, and use feedback-driven learning to refine workflows and module behaviour over time.

features.title: Standardisation
features.desc: Consistent protocols across teams and sites, same module behaviour for Requests, Mortality, Egg and Diet so every record reads the same way.

what-is-antz-systems.title: What is Antz Systems?
what-is-antz-systems.intro: Antz is your all-in-one platform for animal records, daily operations, and team collaboration. It centralises data across sites and departments so every action stays documented, transparent, and traceable.

features.title: Better records, better care
features.desc: Every detail accurate, accessible, time-stamped, and tied to the right animal.

features.title: Teamwork made simple
features.desc: No gaps between vets, caretakers, and managers, everyone on the same record.

features.title: Secure by design
features.desc: Role-based access protects sensitive data and aligns rights with the org chart.

features.title: Decisions at your fingertips
features.desc: Faster reporting and compliance-ready insights, without spreadsheets in the loop.

features.title: Paperless operations
features.desc: Cut transcription errors and save time across every shift.

features.title: Real-time updates
features.desc: Access the latest info anytime, anywhere, across phone, tablet and desktop.
